headlines.text: Back on this day in 2024, the ROH World Heavyweight Title had a new owner by the end of the night as Chris Jericho vs. Mark Briscoe battled it out in a Ladder match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.18 ? ending the champion's reign at 16 defenses. In a bloody Ladder War pitting a legend against a hungry young star, Jericho climbed past a battered Briscoe to pull down the belt and win the ROH World Championship.
Flash back to 2019, when The Lucha Brothers vs. Private Party met in a Tournament Match, getting things started right out of the gate on Dynamite, rated 8.02 ? a fantastic contest.
Rewind to 2021, when Dustin Rhodes was back in action after 6 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: On a Wednesday in 2024, back when Kamille made their AEW debut against Queen Aminata, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.17.
Turning the clock back to 2019: Joey Janela made their return to AEW television after just under 2 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
Flash back to 2019, when Evil Uno stepped back through the curtain after just under 2 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
